guides.name: eBay
guides.file_hint: A .csv file called something like eBay-OrdersReport.csv
guides.what: Your orders from the last few months.
steps: Open eBay on a computer and sign in. Go to Seller Hub (top of the page, under My eBay).
Click Orders, then All orders.
Pick a period at the top. Choose the longest one offered (for example Last 90 days).
Click Download report. If asked, choose All orders and click Download.
The file goes to your Downloads folder. Upload it here.
guides.stock_tip: For stock: Seller Hub > Listings > Active > Download report. Upload that file too.
guides.tip: Upload a new report every week or two. We skip orders you've already uploaded.

guides.name: Amazon
guides.file_hint: A .txt file (that's normal, upload it as it is)
steps: Sign in to Seller Central on a computer.
Open the menu and go to Reports, then Fulfillment.
Under Sales on the left, click All Orders.
Choose a date range (the last 3 to 6 months is ideal) and click Request .txt Download.
Wait a minute, then click Download when it appears. Upload that file here.
guides.stock_tip: For stock: Reports > Fulfillment > Inventory > Manage FBA Inventory, then Request download.
guides.tip: Don't open and re-save the .txt file in Excel first; upload it exactly as Amazon gives it.

guides.name: Shopify
guides.file_hint: A .csv file (big exports arrive by email)
guides.what: Your orders export, and your products export for stock.
steps: Open your Shopify admin and click Orders.
Click Export (top right).
Choose All orders (or a date range of a few months) and Plain CSV file.
Click Export orders. Small exports download straight away; bigger ones are emailed to you.
Upload the file here.
guides.stock_tip: For stock and costs: Products > Export > All products > Export products. Upload that too.
guides.tip: The products export includes Cost per item, which lets us show your real profit.

guides.name: Etsy
guides.file_hint: A .csv file called something like EtsySoldOrderItems2026.csv
guides.what: Your order items (one row per item sold).
steps: Open Shop Manager on a computer.
Go to Settings, then Options, then the Download Data tab.
Under Orders, choose Order Items (not just Orders).
Pick the month and year, or a full year, and click Download CSV.
Upload the file here. Repeat for earlier months to give us more history.
guides.stock_tip: Etsy doesn't export stock in this file. Type your stock in the app, or upload a stock list.
guides.tip: Choose Order Items, not Orders. The Order Items file has the product names we need.

guides.name: TikTok Shop
steps: Open TikTok Shop Seller Center on a computer.
Go to Orders, then Manage orders.
Pick a date range (the last 3 months or more).
Click Export and choose all orders in that range. When it's ready, click Download.
Upload the file here.
guides.stock_tip: For stock: Products > Manage products > Export. Upload that file too.
guides.tip: If Excel shows long order numbers as 5.76E+17, don't worry. Upload the original file.

guides.name: My own spreadsheet or another platform
guides.what: Any sheet with a date, a product name and a quantity on each row.
steps: Make sure the top row has headings, for example: Date | Product | Quantity | Price.
One row per sale (or per product per day). Extra columns are fine; we ignore what we don't need.
Stock can go on a second tab with: Product | Stock | Cost | Price.
Save it as .xlsx or .csv (in Google Sheets: File > Download > .xlsx).
Upload it here. We'll show you what we read before anything is saved.
guides.stock_tip: No stock list? You can type stock for each product in the app after uploading sales.
guides.tip: WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, BigCommerce and most other shops can export orders as CSV.

niches.name: Pet supplies
niches.summary: Pet supplies are one of TikTok Shop's fastest-growing categories. Health and treats lead sales, and smart feeders and fountains are the gadget angle.

items.name: Pet probiotics and dental chews
items.why: Health products top the TikTok Shop pet rankings by sales score.
items.signal: AfterShip's US TikTok Shop pet list ranks weight control, probiotics, collar charms, dog toys and dental chews at the top.

items.name: Kennel and litter odour eliminator
items.why: A cleaning product topped a recent US TikTok Shop pet chart.
items.signal: FindNiche (1 Sep 2026): a kennel odour concentrate at $24.95 led US pet sales with about 2.9K orders in 7 days.

items.name: Collar charms and personalised tags
items.why: Cheap, giftable and very visual on video.
items.signal: Collar charms rank among the top pet product types on AfterShip's TikTok Shop list.

items.name: Build-your-own natural treat bundles
items.why: Bundles lift order value and suit subscription offers.
items.signal: FindNiche UK: a natural dog treat bundle at £7.13 had about 2.3K orders in 7 days.

items.name: Smart feeders and water fountains
items.why: Owners want to look after pets remotely; good margins on gadgets.
items.signal: Named as 2026 opportunities alongside GPS collars and automated toys (GemPages trend guide).

niches.name: Kitchen & household

items.name: Airtight food storage container sets
items.why: Organisation content is huge, and sets raise order value.
items.signal: FindNiche US kitchenware (Jun 2026): a 40-piece airtight set at $19.98 led with about 1.8K orders in 7 days.

items.name: Non-scratch wire dishwashing cloths
items.why: Cheap, repeat purchase, easy to show working.
items.signal: Named as a high-volume TikTok Shop seller in Mega Digital's 2026 roundup.

items.name: Mini waffle and egg sandwich makers
items.why: Compact, giftable, very visual.
items.signal: Listed among high-volume TikTok Shop kitchen sellers in 2026 (Mega Digital).

items.name: Smart soap and kitchen dispensers
items.why: Strong TikTok momentum for touch-free dispensers.
items.signal: An Accio market report links very high TikTok momentum to smart dispensers (single-model sales estimates are unverified).

niches.name: Beauty & skincare

items.name: Collagen overnight masks (K-beauty style)

items.name: Beauty supplements (magnesium, collagen)

items.signal: FastMoss Q2 2026: Toplux Magnesium was #2 ($14.23M); supplements outpace facial skincare.

items.name: LED light therapy masks
items.why: Tech beauty devices with a high price point and strong before/after content.
items.signal: Listed in 2026 TikTok trend roundups as a leading beauty device.

items.name: Ice rollers and gua sha tools
items.why: Low cost, easy demos, good bundle add-ons.
items.signal: Beauty tools are named alongside serums and masks as drivers of impressions and conversion (Trendtrack).

niches.name: Home fitness

items.name: Weighted vests
items.why: Appears in Amazon home-gym best-seller reports.
items.signal: AsInsight's July 2026 home gym report lists a weighted vest among top sellers.

items.name: Resistance band sets
items.why: Under $50, versatile, easy to store.
items.signal: WisePPC's 2026 Amazon fitness list is led by resistance bands, adjustable dumbbells, yoga mats and foam rollers.

items.name: Jump ropes (weighted / smart)

items.name: Portable power banks and neck fans
items.why: Remote work and travel keep demand steady.

items.name: Gaming console accessories for the holidays

items.name: Personalised name and birthstone necklaces
items.why: Gift-driven, meaningful, high perceived value.
items.signal: Outfy's 2026 Etsy guide puts personalised jewellery among Etsy's best-selling items.

items.name: Dainty stacking rings
items.why: Minimalist trend; customers buy several.

items.name: Tumblers and thermoses
items.why: Top of TikTok Shop's US Home & Garden best-seller and growth lists.
items.signal: AfterShip 2026: tumblers lead both best-seller and fastest-growing Home & Garden lists.

items.name: Fragrance oils and candles
items.why: Cosy, giftable, repeat purchase.
items.signal: Fragrance oil and candles appear on AfterShip's TikTok Shop Home & Garden best-seller list.

items.name: Textured throw pillows and rugs in earthy neutrals
items.why: Warm, layered interiors are the 2026 direction.

items.signal: Decorative jars and storage pouches appear in AfterShip's fastest-growing Home & Garden ranking.

niches.name: Baby & kids
niches.summary: A large, steady market where trust and safety come first. Small accessories sell in volume, and toys peak at the holidays.

niches.name: Car & outdoor
niches.summary: Car camping keeps growing: portable power, lighting and simple, app-free gear. Dashboard accessories have seen strong growth.

items.name: Portable power stations and foldable solar panels

items.signal: Global Sources (Jan 2026) lists solar systems and portable power stations among the top camper van accessories.

items.signal: An Accio report cites a 140% annual sales increase for dashboard accessories (figure not independently verified).

holiday.name: Holiday season 2026
holiday.summary: Black Friday is 27 November 2026. Shopping starts weeks earlier, and Cyber Week also lifts everyday essentials.

points.text: Adobe expects the best deals on toys, apparel, appliances and furniture on Black Friday, and on electronics on Cyber Monday.
Adobe forecasts Cyber Week online sales of personal hygiene products up 150% and clothing basics up 210% vs September, with baby, pet and cleaning products also rising.
Buy Now, Pay Later spending is forecast at $21.3 billion for Nov–Dec, up 6.6%, so offering it can lift conversion.
